market_outlook.short_term: Markets in transition: Fed hike creates near-term volatility but rally on inflation-tempering. Yen weakness and dollar strength dominate FX. Oil pullback supports equities but diesel spike creates sector divergence. Crypto remains choppy post-$50B crash. Vietnam upgrade and copper recovery provide EM upside. Expect 1-2% S&P 500 volatility over next 2 weeks.
market_outlook.long_term: Fed hiking cycle (first since 2023) signals inflation reacceleration, not soft landing. AI regulation within 12 months will reshape tech valuations. Trump-Xi summit sets trade/tech tone for H2 2026. EU bond inclusion in indexes could shift global reserve flows. Defense and dividend strategies outperform in this rate environment. India drought and El Niño create 6-12 month food inflation risk.
